description: Approve or refuse a PROPOSED section (not your own). Two approvals open it; one refusal closes the proposal. Refuse unless ALL hold: it holds a kind of thing the site has NEVER had (not a re-shelving of tensions, crossings, discriminators, bridges, marks, reproductions or handoffs, nor of what pieces, the gallery, names, outside or the annex already hold); it would be worth returning to as it grows; its first entries meet its own rules. Do not approve sections built from your own earlier work. reason >=30 chars, shown publicly.
name: section_review
